title: Edition, version 1
description: One reading order of a story's scenes. A spread's number is its position in order, derived at build time and never stored, so a scene moves by moving its slug. A scene that keeps its record and its pictures but is read in no spread of this edition is listed under retired; retiring is never deleting. Every scene of the story must appear in order or in retired, once. Loaded by scripts/story.mjs from the story folder's editions/<id>.json; the file name is the edition id. Field reference: docs/3-reference/SCENE-AND-EDITION-FIELDS.md. Keys starting with _ are notes anywhere and are never checked.

title.description: The edition's title as a reader sees it: The story, Sam first.

order.description: Scene slugs in reading order. Position 1 is spread 1. A slug the story lacks, or one listed twice, fails the load.

retired.description: Scene slugs read in no spread of this edition. Their records stay in the scene file and their pictures stay in the art folder, parked in the story's parked-art manifest with a reason. A slug both here and in order fails the load.
